import numpy as np, collections, itertools
def stats_of_pair(p):
    d=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {p} input']); o=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {p} output'])
    H,W=d.shape; bg=int(d[0][0])
    An=[(r,c,int(d[r][c])) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if d[r][c]!=bg]
    # group anomalies by color
    byc=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for (r,c,v) in An: byc[v].append((r,c))
    true={tuple(x) for x in map(tuple,np.argwhere(o==1 & (d==bg)))}
    out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if d[r][c]==bg:
                orth=collections.Counter()
                diag=collections.Counter()
                for dr,dc,name in [(-1,0,'U'),(1,0,'D'),(0,-1,'L'),(0,1,'R'),(-1,-1,'UL'),(-1,1,'UR'),(1,-1,'DL'),(1,1,'DR')]:
                    rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
                    if (0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W) and (rr,cc) in {(a[0],a[1]) for a in An}:
                        if (dr,dc) in [(0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)]: orth[d[rr][cc]]+=1
                        else: diag[d[rr][cc]]+=1
                key=(tuple(sorted(byc.items())), (r,c) in true, tuple(sorted(orth.items())), tuple(sorted(diag.items())))

    return out, bg, byc, true

import numpy as np, collections
def solve(d):
    d=np.array(d); H,W=d.shape
    dom=collections.Counter(d.flatten().tolist()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    An=[(r,c,int(d[r][c])) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if d[r][c]!=dom]
    out=d.copy()
    # fill bg cell if on straight segment (8 dirs) between two anomalies
    def midpoints(p,q):
        dr=q[0]-p[0]; dc=q[1]-p[1]
        g=collections.gcd(abs(dr),abs(dc)) or 1
        if abs(dr) % g != 0 or abs(dc) % g != 0: return []
        step=(dr//g,dc//g)
        res=[]
        cur=p
        while True:
            nxt=cur+step
            if nxt==q: break
            cur=nxt
            # points strictly between, all background
            res.append((cur[0]+step[0],cur[1]+step[1]))
        return res
    for i in range(len(An)):
        for j in range(i+1,len(An)):
            for p in midpoints(An[i],An[j]):
                if 0<=p[0]<H and 0<=p[1]<W and d[p]==dom:
                    out[p]=1
    return out.tolist()
ok=True
for p in range(1,9):
    d=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {p} input']); o=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {p} output'])
    pred=solve(d.tolist())
    m = np.array_equal(np.array(pred),o)
    print('pair',p,m)
    ok = ok and m
print('ALL:',ok)

import numpy as np, json, os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
a=np.array(load()['Test input']); b=a.copy()
from scipy import ndimage
lab,n=ndimage.label(a!=7)
mask=np.zeros_like(a,bool)
for i in range(1,n+1):
    ys,xs=np.where(lab==i)
    if len(ys)>1: mask[lab==i]=True
b[a!=7&~mask]=7
print(json.dumps(b.tolist()))
